answer: Insider could mint many fake identities using same stake. Sybil resistance mechanism: each identity must bond unique non-transferable credential—birth certificate hash from trusted issuer. Bonded credential burned at first payout, producing irreversible on-chain record. Constraint means privileged operator cannot re-register same real-world identity after exit. This dawn of reputation-backed agent economies uses violet pigment of cryptographic uniqueness to color each actor permanent.
